parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two children who are three years old.

text: Prepare, cook and serve five skilful dishes, each to show the use of a different piece of equipment

parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal to celebrate a traditional festival.

method.

parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes, each to show the use of a different vegetable.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using a local fruit and make a batch of small cakes or a tray bake.

parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two female neighbours who have both
recently given birth and are lactating.

parts.label: (b)

(NSP) / dietary fibre.
